items.original: Founded in Houston and led by Dr. Eugene Lou, ThrIVe Drip Spa modernized IV therapy with a spa-grade lounge experience. Ten lounges across Texas.

items.original: ThrIVe Drip Spa is an IV vitamin therapy and lifestyle wellness spa that took traditional medical treatments and gave them a modern, refreshing twist. Whether your needs are reparative or preventative, IV therapy is the only process that ensures up to 100% of nutrients are absorbed.

items.original: ThrIVe was founded in Houston as the first IV therapy drip spa in Texas. The idea was simple: the treatments that keep patients hydrated and nourished in hospitals — a liter of fluids, vitamins straight to the bloodstream — shouldn't require a hospital. So we built a lounge.
items.text: ThrIVe was founded in Houston as the first IV therapy drip spa in Texas. The idea was simple: the treatments that keep patients hydrated and nourished in hospitals — a liter of fluids, vitamins straight to the bloodstream — shouldn't require a hospital. So we built a lounge.

items.original: Today ThrIVe is a franchised brand with ten lounges across Greater Houston, Dallas and Fort Worth, a mobile concierge service, and a menu that has grown from twelve signature drips into NAD+, weight-loss therapy and the full BTL body-and-face suite. Every drip is still formulated by physicians and pharmacists, and administered by registered nurses after a Good Faith Exam.

items.original: ThrIVe's CEO and founder is an MIT graduate who studied genetics and molecular biology and published alongside three Nobel laureates at the Whitehead Institute. He has practiced as an orthopedic surgeon for more than 20 years.
